headline: Follow power through your E3/DC system
intro: Connect an E3/DC home power station to Home Assistant over local Modbus TCP. Once configured, the integration polls the station every five seconds for live power-flow and battery readings.
highlights: Track PV, house, grid, and battery power alongside battery charge, self-consumption, and self-sufficiency readings
See status signals for charging locks, forecast-limited charging, feed-in limits, and emergency-power readiness
Wallbox power sensors appear when a wallbox is configured; additional-feeder power appears when a supported external meter is present

flow.title: From local connection to power readings
stages: Enable Modbus TCP with E3/DC protocol in the Smart Home menu
Discover the station or enter its host and Modbus port
Poll power flows, battery readings, and available status sensors
